notes.title: Version 1.1.0 (Redux)
notes.notes:
Key updates
[list]
[*] [b]Native Fullscreen mode is supported.[/b] 
     Select it using "Window type" in the launcher dialog.
[*] [b]Game no longer requires a separate Java download[/b]. 
     It has its own private JRE.
[*] Updates to some default graphics settings.
[*] Removed UI items related to deprecated online features.
[*] 32-bit Windows is no longer supported.
[/list]
The game will keep your settings and game progress from previous local installations on Windows PCs. Unfortunately the Mac OSX version does not retain these.

If there are any critical issues there's a beta branch you can use to go back to the last pre-1.1.0 version.

As always please let me know on the Community page how you get on.

Josh S.

notes.title: Version 1.04 Released
notes.notes:
Version 1.04 release notes:

[list]
[*] Steam API integration now uses the latest version of Steamworks4J: 1.8.0
[*] If Steam API integration prevents the game launching (reported by several users on Windows 10), it can be disabled in the "Install" tab of the settings dialog.
[*] The latest version of Launch4J is used on Windows, which may improve JRE integration.
[*] Game is tested on, and marked as supporting 64-bit Mac OSX. 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.03 released
notes.notes: Microfix: proper error reporting when trying to create a user with an invalid user ID on Tricone Lab Online.

notes.title: Version 1.02 released
notes.notes:
This maintenance release contains the following:
[list]
[*] A fix to the tricone lab online feature. So, looking at level stats and downloading  / uploading custom maps should now be working again.
[*] A bug fix to a pretty fundamental geometry issue deep in the code. This change should make the game run a bit faster and also may fix some other bugs such as weird behaviour on the map screens.
[*] I added a 4K resolution option. To be honest I am not sure if this works properly as I don't have a big enough test monitor. But it should be OK.
[/list]
Apologies for the long delay in getting this release out. 

Have fun with Tricone Lab!

josh

notes.title: Early Access Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, it’s been a while since I last gave you an update so I thought I’d give you an overview of what’s happened so far in early access. As a solo developer working on this on top of a full-time job, this has been a long process, but a really rewarding one, and all your feedback and input has been hugely appreciated.

Here’s a breakdown of the four key areas that have been improved upon in Early Access:

1.	Difficulty curve has been improved to create a more rewarding experience and help players progress more naturally through the game.
2.	A number of new and improved Steam Achievements have been implemented.
3.	A number of bug-fixes and other graphical improvements.
4.	Full testing and improvement of the level editing and sharing capabilities

As well as all this, a good number of community-created maps have been given “approved” status as part of Tricone Lab Online’s quality control procedures. There are now 4 additional maps containing 20 levels. These can all be found on the Tricone Lab Community Server.

You can find full breakdowns of the above updates here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/392610/allnews/

[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/xUA7b88f7rOVptQRR6/giphy.gif]

Keep an eye out for more Tricone news this week - I've got some exciting news to share.

Thanks,
Josh

notes.title: 0.17-beta release notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] in-game audio settings
[*] hidden border join nodes do not auto-delete where strong meets normal, previously this allowed unpredictable border strength in custom levels
[*] fixed the bug where you see a wee black dot on a selected closed loop 
[*] better level name validation in the editor
[*] fixed NullPointerException during "save map as", when the map was empty
[*] changed window decorations checkbox to "with borders" / "borderless" combo
[*] constructor borders only snip back for up to the last 20 vertices, beyond that point they block themselves
[/list]
